title: How do you make an AI drone video fly through a front door in one shot?
description: Give the model two pictures instead of a paragraph. With start_image and end_image set, composition is locked at both ends and the prompt only has to describe motion.

faq.q: How do you control camera movement in an AI video?
faq.a: Stop describing the camera and pin the endpoints. Setting start_image and end_image means the model is no longer inventing a shot — it is solving for the path between two frames you already chose, so the prompt only has to describe motion and light.

faq.q: Why do AI video prompts about camera moves usually fail?
faq.a: Because a written camera move has to survive the model's interpretation of composition at the same time. Locking both frames removes composition from the problem entirely.
